files.description:
Night in Chacahua, crickets and waves in background 
During the night in the Laguna of Chacahua. Some crickets are singing, sound of the pacific ocean in background.
Recorded by a binaural of 2 Sanken Cos11D on an Olympus LS5
Original recording in Wave 96k 24b
Ref: MX-130110
